ai_summary: Fischer Medical Ventures Limited has announced the conversion of 4,54,210 warrants held by its promoter, FMV Holdings Pte Ltd, into new equity shares at an issue price of Rs. 23.40 per share. This transaction injects approximately Rs. 79.71 lakhs into the company's capital, bolstering its financial resources. The conversion increases the promoter's stake while diluting the overall equity base, representing a standard corporate action for pre-allotted warrants with no immediate red flags evident from the disclosure itself.
